# Evidence commentary

The fixture distinguishes a statement about verification from a concrete
quantity, checking actor, method, condition, attribution, or protected phrase.
Each expected finding identifies the complete commentary clause and preserves
the technical premise or the check described after it. The opaque-premise case
uses wording from the frozen public Ptah configuration source.

The harness materializes BOM and CRLF, then compares annotated source locations,
CLI diagnostics, and SARIF with the reviewed golden files. These are functional
cases, not corpus precision or broad recall qualification.
